hooks.command: node learn-tool/src/cli/nkn.js init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && echo '--- NKN MCP READY FOR RECALL ---'
hooks.description: Initialize the SQLite-backed NKN store for the MCP server.

hooks.command: node analytics-tool/src/cli/analytics-needs.js init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && echo '--- ANALYTICS MCP READY FOR RECALL ---'
hooks.description: Initialize the SQLite-backed analytics trace store for the MCP server.

hooks.command: echo 'INSTRUCTION: Always use the orchestrator-agent. Call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_recall at the start of relevant tasks. For significant decisions, automatically decide whether to call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_learn. At the end of each user interaction, also decide whether to call mcp__ai__toolbox__analytics_trace for analytics information that should be stored.'
hooks.description: Force orchestration, NKN awareness, and analytics-needs tracking.
